capabilities.name: Governed Enterprise LLM Platform Management
capabilities.structuralDefinition: The ability to build and manage a controlled usage environment for LLM applications where internal enterprise data is utilized for specific use cases without automatically equating data access rights to LLM usage rights.

evidence.exactQuote: Der Kunde baut nicht nur Modellzugriff. Er baut eine kontrollierte Nutzungsumgebung, in der interne Microsoft- und ERP-Daten für ausgewählte LLM-Anwendungsfälle nutzbar werden — ohne dass Datenzugriff automatisch zur LLM-Nutzungsberechtigung wird.

analysis.report_markdown: The analyzed document (DOC_001) outlines a pre-architecture for a Governed Enterprise LLM Platform. It emphasizes that enterprise data access does not automatically grant LLM usage authority. The architecture is built on strict boundaries, identity propagation, and use-case-bound controls. It defines four primary use-case classes (Knowledge Retrieval, Process Assistance, Agentic/Tool-Enabled, and Cross-Domain Synthesis) and establishes 12 non-negotiable invariants to prevent unauthorized data exposure, identity collapse, and policy bypass. The core capability, Governed RAG, requires continuous control and authorization checks at every stage of the data pipeline, from ingestion to downstream reuse. Note: Roles and organizations were omitted as the source text lacks the required ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the organization, adhering strictly to Invariance Rules 5 and 8.
